import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    mod = 1000000007
    size = 2 * n + 1
    dp = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    dp[1][1] = 1

    for i in range(2, size):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if j > 0:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
            if j < size - 1:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j + 1]) % mod

    ans = 0
    for i in range(2 * n - 1, -1, -2):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if (2 * n - i) >= j:
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % mod

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
